post_call_analysis_data.name: business_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's own business name, if given.

post_call_analysis_data.name: business_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's kind of business (for example: plumbing, med spa, dental, law firm, auto repair, real estate, cleaning).

post_call_analysis_data.name: booked
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if a call with our AI specialist was booked on this call.

post_call_analysis_data.name: appointment_time
post_call_analysis_data.description: The booked call's day and time in plain words. Empty if none.

post_call_analysis_data.name: sms_ok
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if the caller clearly said yes to receiving a text message.

post_call_analysis_data.name: urgent
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller asked the founder to call back today, or reported a real emergency.

post_call_analysis_data.name: lead_temperature
post_call_analysis_data.description: Hot: wants to book or start. Warm: interested, not ready. Cold: not interested or not a business owner.

post_call_analysis_data.name: main_problem
post_call_analysis_data.description: The visitor's main problem or bottleneck, in their words.

post_call_analysis_data.name: solution_fit
post_call_analysis_data.description: What fits best: Essential, Answer, Capture, Command, a website, or a custom AI build (automation, agents, infrastructure), with one line why.

post_call_analysis_data.name: team_size
post_call_analysis_data.description: About how many people work there, if said.

post_call_analysis_data.name: timeline
post_call_analysis_data.description: How soon they want it fixed, in their words.

post_call_analysis_data.name: decision_maker
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if they said they make the decision.

post_call_analysis_data.name: email
post_call_analysis_data.description: The email they confirmed for the booking or link. Empty if none.
